newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Record low yield may not satisfy Portugal Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Record low yield may not satisfy Portugal Treasury.

text.p: Bids at Portugal's auction on Tuesday of 20 billion escudos of three-year bonds were expected at a record low 6.75 to 6.85 percent, but this may still not fully satisfy the Treasury, analysts said.
Although the yields would be a shade below current secondary market levels, they would be significantly above those of Spain and the Treasury could opt not to place all the paper, they said.
The results from the sale of the March 1999 bonds will be announced around 1000 GMT on Tuesday.
At the last such sale on September 10, the Treasury placed 17.85 billion escudos at a weighted average of 7.5291 percent and a minimum of 7.51 percent.
The bonds closed on the secondary market at 6.87 percent on Monday, 26 basis points above the Spanish equivalent.
